rules.title: Rules
items: Warm-up|5–8 minutes of light cardio plus 1–3 warm-up sets of the first exercise. They don't count as working sets.
Intensity|Finish most sets with 1–3 reps in reserve. You don't need to go to failure every time.
Progression|Hit the top of the range in every set with clean form? Add a little weight and start again from the bottom of the range.
Rest|Compound lifts (presses, rows, leg press): 2–3 minutes. Isolation: 60–120 seconds.
Recovery|Very sore, form getting worse, or joints aching? Move the workout to another day.
Missed days|Missed a couple of days? Don't start over, just continue with the next workout.
rules.stopText: Sharp pain, joint pain, numbness or any unusual sensation: stop the exercise and find out the cause.

gate.lead: Add the app to your Home Screen first. It takes about half a minute.
why: Works offline, even with no signal at the gym.
Opens full screen, like a regular app.
Your data stays in the app on your phone.
gate.warn: Data in the browser and in the installed app are separate and don't carry over. Use the installed app so your workouts aren't lost.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
body: The app has no accounts, ads, cookies or tracking.
Your profile, plan, workouts and notes are stored only on your device and are never sent to any server.
The app makes no requests to third-party services: fonts and scripts are served from our own site.
The hosting provider (GitHub Pages) may log IP addresses on its side when the site is opened.
You can delete all your data at any time in Settings.

terms.title: Terms of use
body: The app is free and provided as is, without warranties.
You must be 16 or older to use the app.
The app helps you plan and log workouts. It does not give advice on body weight, nutrition or appearance.
Listen to your body: stop an exercise if you feel pain or discomfort.
